svg.text: A real stateless signature, from bytes on the wire to the public-key root.

g.text: one 16 B secret + 12 × 16 B siblings per tree
gray: secret prefix gold: signature blue: verifier
WOTS+ key is one selected leaf.
one XMSS tree; then sign its root at the next layer
FORS key → seven XMSS layers → public root
Tree silhouettes are schematic; all seven layers are shown.
